card.name: Confederate generals before Jackson
card.fires_on: Small words and titles just before a Civil War name, especially General or a comma or 'and' after Confederate names, where 'Stonewall' Jackson is likely to come next.

modes.label: Title before Jackson
modes.description: The word General, Gen., or a quote mark right before Jackson or Stonewall in Civil War text.
modes.example: Intelligence from Winchester leads to the belief that<< General>> Jackson is there in full force.

modes.label: Lists of Confederate names
modes.description: A comma or 'and' in a list of Confederate leaders such as Lee and Davis.

modes.label: Command phrases
modes.description: Words like 'under' or 'by' linking troops to a Confederate commander.
modes.example: troops commanded<< by>> Jackson will clash with a far larger Union

card.writes: It seems to push toward wall-type words as in Stonewall, and away from unrelated tokens.
card.plain: It fires in American Civil War text just before the name Stonewall Jackson is expected.
